versions.changelog:
Proof DM skill launches: write concise, high-reply LinkedIn DMs grounded in real customer proof and a proven influence principle.

- Produces ready-to-send, ≤80-word LinkedIn DMs using one sharp customer proof point—never filler or fabrication.
- Leverages either real GrowthNation MCP-supplied proof or credible web-sourced case studies; falls back to role-based claims if none found.
- Selects and states ONE influence principle (peer proof, hard ROI, etc.) matched to recipient’s role for maximum relevance.
- Requires only name, role, company, and offer; prompts for missing input and runs standalone on web if MCP unavailable.
- Output includes DM, influence rationale, proof trace, and researched mode for transparency; closes with soft next-step suggestion.
